items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Especially one, Charley Johnson, that was a great help to me and showed me the ropes and how to go about it, and all.

ctx.x: I'd gone to Atlantic City with a lady that was an entertainer. And she was older than I was and she was trying to run things like she wanted. She said, 'Well, here I got my stooge and I'll take him on with me and we'll have a good time together. And when I get tired, I'll toss him off.' But, in the meantime, I met two or three fellows down there. Especially one, Charley Johnson, that was a great help to me and showed me the ropes and how to go about it, and all. So, he showed me how to do a lot of things. In…
broke in the place. Because these fellows were waiting for us. Well, we come in.
